problems_fixed.new: AC a diameter, angle BAC = 34, B and D on opposite sides of AC. Find angle ADB. (answer 56)

opener_concept: A bicycle wheel on flat ground: the spoke pointing to the tyre's contact point makes 90 degrees with the road (pure common sense). The reveal names the road as a tangent and the spoke as a radius, then a leaning stick splits the right angle (90 - 25 = 65) to preview the 'use one angle to reach the next' stepping-stone move used across the tiers.
